newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metra's Sanitec in Asia venture.
newsitem.headline: Metra's Sanitec in Asia venture.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Metra Oy Ab said on Wednesday its Sanitec bathroom ceramics unit plans to invest 55 million markka to form a 50/50 joint venture with Johnson Suisse Singapore Pte Ltd.

"This acquisition gives Sanitec a strong foothold in the growing Asian markets and possibilities to expand the markets for Sanitec's European products," Sanitec president Henrik Eklund said in a statement.
"Johnson Suisse has net sales of 100 million markka and it is a profitable company," Metra said.
Johnson Suisse has a sanitaryware factory in Kuala Lumpur and subsidiaries in Singapore and Australia, and it exports to Hong Kong and Australia, it said.
It produces 600,000 ceramic pieces a year and has about 350 employees, Metra said.
The company's main owner is Swedish investor Curt Borgensten, who bought it in 1989, it said.
